contexts.text: The window (in the ark, ) = the Intellectual. AC 655, Explained, Illustrated.
The suns, or windows () = intellectual things from charity. Explained.
All the windows of the Temple... represented the same; the highest of them, intellectual things; the middle, rational things; and the lowest, scientifics and sensuous things... (). AC 658.
Windows of the middle story are meant (in ) and = rational things... ( = intellectual things. AC 2348:end.)
As windows = intellectual and rational things, which are of truth, they also = reasonings which are of falsity. Illustrated.
Noah opened the window of the ark () = the second state, when the truths of faith appeared to him... For a window = the Intellectual, and therefore the truths of faith.
When their homes are changed, there appears something at the side that represents a window...

Abimelech... looked through a window () = the doctrine of faith looking at rational things in Knowledges... For a window = the Intellectual, and therefore the internal sight... so that to look through a window = to perceive the things which appear by the internal sight, which, in general, are Knowledges, which are of the external man.
That windows = the things of the internal sight, that is, of the understanding, which, in one word, are called intellectual things. Illustrated.
To enter in by the windows as a thief () = to destroy truths and the Knowledges of them. AC 5135:9. AC 8906:2. AE 193:7.
A voice shall sing in the windows () = the desolation of truth, thus of the intellectual faculty as to truth. ( = the preaching of what is false. AE 650:57.)
To look forth through a window () = by means of the reasonings of those who deny truth...
A face seen above an azure window. Explained.
The interior membranes (of the ear) called windows.
These Spirits... see a face in a window, which is a sign for them to depart.
Their dwellings had windows at the sides according to the number of the... chambers... The windows were made of threads of grassy threads so interwoven that the light passed through.
When (such) look through the windows, it is as if through pure crystals.
Self-love has closed the window in its roof... and also the side windows...
The Lord (then) opens the window in his roof, and afterwards the side windows...
A window = truth in light.

I wanted to look in through a window, but there was none... But a window was suddenly made on the right side; and I heard them complain that they were in darkness. Presently a window was made on the left side, that on the right being closed, and the darkness was then slowly dissipated...
The lofty windows (of the palace), of the most transparent crystal, had posts of gold.
On each side (of the house) were three lofty windows of crystalline glass, the posts of which were of olive-wood... No windows were seen in the east wall.
A window was (then) made where none was seen before, and a voice was heard through it...
[155a]. The wives looked at a window in the southern quarter, and there was seen a white dove...
The palace had three rows of windows (through which the three kinds of birds flew). Described.
I looked through a window to the east, and saw seven women sitting on a bed of roses... CL 294.
On seeing (the Satans) I closed the window; yet I spoke to them through it.
There were no windows in the walls (of the temple) but a great opening in the middle of the roof... which lighted it better than if there had been windows at the sides.
The walls (of the magnificent temple) were continuous windows of crystals... This temple = the New Church... its windows of crystals, the Truths that enlighten it.
There appeared to me a face in a window, from which I might infer that I should see something worthy of observation.
Augustus showed me a round, or oval, window that he had in his palace. Explained.

(In the Hell of the Genii) there were walls as of a great building, but... instead of windows there were great openings... For they cannot dwell in houses that have... windows... for they feel as if they were being suffocated. The reason is that windows = the things that are of thought.
When they are (spiritually) dead, there appear no windows in the houses, but only openings, within which it is dark. But when they are alive, windows appear, and men in them.
Windows, etc. = the things of a mind that receives... (namely) that of the mind which is called the understanding...
To fly... as doves to the windows () = the thorough investigation of truth... Windows = truth in light. AE 406:10.
Death hath come up through the windows... () = that infernal falsity has entered into the understanding. AE 652:27.
Windows = the thoughts from the understanding.
To open the windows of heaven, and pour forth a blessing () = the Divine inflowing, from which come intelligence and eternal life.
With the windows closed.
